description:
Review Windows driver inventory and available update offers before changing your PC.

Tweaky Driver brings detected devices, installed versions and available driver offers into one review workflow. Check each offer and its source before changing a working PC. Free includes one complete scan of supported sources every 10 days and requires a free account with a verified email; drivers found remain available to download and install until the next scan unlocks. Device inventory and read-only diagnostics remain available between scans. Pro removes scan limits and adds saved jobs and offline kits. Some packages are download-only. Discovery depends on supported sources and compatible packages; a detected offer does not guarantee compatibility or a performance improvement.
Routine maintenance update.
